text:
micah: Heads-up, apiserver error-rate just spiked in eu1 around 11:07 UTC. Seeing lots of 502/503s and controller-manager leader flips.
priya: saw it too, graphs show request queue depth jump and conn_count on proxies maxed.
jordan: any recent infra changes? autoscale or BGP drift?
micah: there was an ASG scale (worker-side) 5m before, but controlplane nodes also reported transient route changes from our peering partner.
anika: digging into apiserver logs — many "upstream connect error or disconnect" and TCP RSTs to etcd endpoints. sample: 
```
E0311 11:07:04.123 apiserver.go:234] 503 POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods (10.0.5.7:42344)  
UpstreamConnectError: failed to dial etcd: dial tcp 10.2.0.5:2379: connect: connection refused
```
priya: pulled metrics: apiserver request latency p99 went from 80ms -> 2.4s; etcd follower lag increased briefly.
sre-bot: Incident created #INC-20250311-1120. Auto-scaling paused for controlplane group.
jordan: controller-manager leader toggling every ~30s, probably because apiserver failing healthchecks. leader-election TTL shows renew failures.
anika: running etcdctl --endpoints=10.2.0.5:2379 endpoint status, one endpoint not responding. sample output: 
```
$ ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=10.2.0.5:2379 endpoint status
10.2.0.5:2379 is unreachable: dial tcp 10.2.0.5:2379: i/o timeout
10.2.0.6:2379 healthy
```
micah: ops team, did we push any network ACL updates? Could be a NAT gateway rotate causing ephemeral conn exhaustion.
oncall-ops: we rotated NAT EIPs in eu1 at 11:05 to reattach after maintenance, we did see a short spike in conn creation. Might have stressed conntrack on the controlplane proxies.
priya: that matches — proxy conntrack hit somaxconn and we saw SYN_RECV backlog growth. tcp drop counters on the edge increased.
jordan: mitigation plan: 1) scale apiserver replicas up by 2 (fast), 2) roll controlplane proxies to bump conntrack thresholds + enable conn reuse, 3) redeploy etcd pod from unreachable node if still offline.
anika: I'm patching apiserver qps/burst temporarily lower to reduce leader churn for controller-manager. Also enabling read-only fallback to follower endpoints for some read paths.
micah: doing scale now: kubectl -n kube-system scale deployment/apiserver --replicas=5 (was 3).
priya: watching metrics, request queue length dropped 35% after second replica came up. etcd follower catch-up started.
oncall-ops: we've reattached old EIP to NATG and increased conntrack table size on proxies as immediate relief. will follow up with kernel tuning PR.
ijordan: note for postmortem: correlate ASG scale timing, NAT EIP rotate, conntrack exhaustion, and controller-manager lease TTL. Also list cost impact for forced extra apiserver replicas + NAT changes.
anika: collecting logs and etcd snapshots now, will upload to incident channel.
sre-bot: Alert cleared at 11:22 UTC. Monitoring will keep elevated retention for 48h. :white_check_mark:
micah: thanks all — keep an eye on eu1 for next 2 hours, file a follow-up runbook entry for NATEIP rotations and conntrack pre-checks. :thumbsup:
